newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline pressured lower by aggressive sellers.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline pressured lower by aggressive sellers.

text.p: NWE gasoline was slightly lower on Wednesday as continuing high stocks and aggressive selling put the market under pressure, traders said.
Prompt Eurograde material for pre-April 15 delivery was offered at $191 and later at $190 fob ARA by a couple of players.
"If you're in a position to take material in the next few days it's cheap, but it's not where the market really is," said a broker.
Traders said one of the aggressive players was trying to off-load material it purchased last month with the intention of shipping out of the area.
"I think the intention originally was to ship it out of the region, but in the end they only shipped out the odd parcel hear and there," said one player.
Other sellers said they were staying on the sidelines for the time being.
One player was heard bidding for full April material at $190.50 fob ARA.
On the regular front, a small parcel traded at $185 in early trade.
